label: QueryOptions (client-side SQL++ request configuration)
type: the options object passed to Cluster.query()/Scope.query() controlling per-request behavior - named parameters, scanConsistency, readonly, adhoc (prepared-statement caching), profile - distinct from the SQL++ statement text itself
note: Recurs across concept-docs/n1ql-query.json, howtos/sqlpp-queries-with-sdk.json (whose one relation here carries the pre-gate link-boundary artifact) and ref/client-settings.json. dependsOnService/hasInternalComponent relations to sdk:sqlpp-queries-with-sdk.
